verdict.rationale: Paxos is a stablecoin and crypto platform, so agent wallet custody is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence documents no programmatic wallet issuance for agents, no spend policies, and no documented limits on what an agent can move. The only nearby item is OAuth client credentials with endpoint scopes (paxos-docs-2, paxos-docs-48). That is general API access control, an adjacent feature that earns no credit for agent-specific wallet safety.
